notes: S2/F55 (§11.6 item 5, §13, §14.5 U8): records/ holds an unlisted file with an upper-case (so misnamed) hex name and 1,048,577 bytes. A records/ file is subject to MAX_RECORD_BYTES whether or not it is listed, so the records-listing phase reports both independent violations: E_MANIFEST_RECORD_EXTRA and E_JSON_SIZE.
